row: UCA offers 160 undergraduate, masters, and doctoral degree programs. The diverse array of academic offerings at UCA gives students the opportunities they need to pursue their interests, and each academic program is grounded in a philosophy that emphasizes habits of mind and ways of relating to the world. At UCA, the faculty and students engage with the campus and community in teaching-learning partnerships that promote intellectual and personal success.
